jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete OLD BOXER LEFT SIDE PROFILE, facing SCREEN LEFT, portrait 2:3. Input Image 1 = current upright FRONT reference, sole authority for dimensions, colors, anatomy, panel layout and relaxed fists-low pose. Image 2 = current master, reference for armor connection and helmet identity ONLY; do NOT use its punching pose or perspective enlargement.
Preserve image1's exact upright adult body and physical lengths: SAME helmet size/height, shoulder and elbow level, hip axis, thigh length, knee height, long heavy shins, ankle level and soles. Do not compress the head or make body short/stocky. Current front body is the proportion authority, not the older crouching/punching pose. Keep both gloves the same actual dimensions, broad tan shoulder drums with ivory ring and small red inset, ivory upper arms, tan forearm cuffs, charcoal elbow/wrist joints, segmented ivory abdomen, tan pelvis and short ivory skirt plates. Palette exclusively warm ivory/cream, matte tan/earth-brown, deep red accents and charcoal; only amber eyes at front. Mature retired boxing mecha, dignified clean paint with limited repaired panel seams and a few rubbed edges. No crown, horns, wings, weapons, shield, drill, fuel tanks, giant backpack or thrusters. Clean KINETIC CEL mechanical illustration with crisp contours and broad two-tone shadows, same finish as image1. Plain warm white background. No text, numbers, arrows, logos, captions, multiple figures or action. Whole helmet through soles in frame with generous margins.
Rotate the SAME robot ninety degrees around vertical axis into LEFT SIDE; no 3/4 chest display, no camera tilt. Feet still flat in same upright pose, pointing LEFT with heels RIGHT, no crouch. Near anatomical LEFT arm/leg, far right arm/leg naturally overlap at same heights.
Head profile retains short rectangular red forehead block, ivory/tan helmet dome, small dark temple/ear structure, heavy squared ivory/brown cheek-jaw; only a sliver amber eye at FRONT left. No visor/face on back of helmet, no oversized ear antenna.
Chest projects LEFT; paired ivory pectoral plates and red slots stay on front, mostly edge-on from profile. Do not put chest vents on side. Thick tan shoulder drum seen as broad outer cap with ivory rim and red inset; same upper/lower-arm lengths. Fist held low at upper-thigh level like FRONT, elbow slightly bent, NOT raised guard. Glove shows thick IVORY back shell at REAR/right, deep RED segmented knuckle face at FRONT/left with correct thumb and wrist cuff attachment. It is one closed fist, no extra glove pasted on.
LEFT leg is the repaired leg: big IVORY replacement front/outer thigh face, IVORY kneecap with red lower inset, tan/ivory shin armor and dark circular knee/ankle pivots. Far RIGHT leg has tan thigh and red kneecap; only show naturally visible far edges, don't mirror left armor onto it. Long heavy shins retain length. Wide flat boxing boot points LEFT: red TOE at LEFT, coherent tan/ivory middle, dark ankle and short red heel protector RIGHT.
Rear torso is a compact service backplate/collar only, not a bulky jet pack. Same silhouette and physical pose as front, side projection not an unrelated redesign.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete OLD BOXER TRUE REAR view, portrait 2:3. Input Image1 is calibrated upright FRONT, sole body proportion/armor/pose authority. Input Image2 current master for identity/connection only, not punching pose. Turn SAME robot exactly 180 degrees; no 3/4, no face visible.
Preserve image1's exact upright adult body and physical lengths: SAME helmet size/height, shoulder and elbow level, hip axis, thigh length, knee height, long heavy shins, ankle level and soles. Do not compress the head or make body short/stocky. Current front body is the proportion authority, not the older crouching/punching pose. Keep both gloves the same actual dimensions, broad tan shoulder drums with ivory ring and small red inset, ivory upper arms, tan forearm cuffs, charcoal elbow/wrist joints, segmented ivory abdomen, tan pelvis and short ivory skirt plates. Palette exclusively warm ivory/cream, matte tan/earth-brown, deep red accents and charcoal; only amber eyes at front. Mature retired boxing mecha, dignified clean paint with limited repaired panel seams and a few rubbed edges. No crown, horns, wings, weapons, shield, drill, fuel tanks, giant backpack or thrusters. Clean KINETIC CEL mechanical illustration with crisp contours and broad two-tone shadows, same finish as image1. Plain warm white background. No text, numbers, arrows, logos, captions, multiple figures or action. Whole helmet through soles in frame with generous margins.
Back helmet is IVORY/TAN faceted shell with short RED central crest continuing over top as narrow red edge, charcoal nape and short neck. No eyes, brow mask or mouth on rear. Retain front helmet's tall normal volume.
Back torso: interpret source upper shoulder/neck collar as a modest IVORY upper back guard with red inset edging. Below it a compact TAN/BROWN central armored maintenance hatch with one small recessed dark rectangular cooling grille and coherent segment seams; ivory side structural plates. NO paired frontal ivory breastplates/red chest slots copied onto rear; no new jet engines, huge pipes or added weapons. Dark articulated lower back and source waist retain same heights.
ARMS: matching tan round shoulder drum backs/ivory rings/red small inserts. Ivory upper-arm rear panels, charcoal elbows, tan wrist cuffs; both gloves are LOW beside upper thighs as front. In REAR show broad IVORY armored glove BACKS and coherent wrists. Deep red knuckle faces point toward robot FRONT and are mostly hidden, only red wrap/edge details naturally visible. Do not paint full front red finger knuckles on glove backs. Same closed fist shapes, not open hands.
Preserve physical side assignment of repaired armor: anatomical RIGHT now viewer RIGHT has tan thigh and red kneecap on its FRONT (hidden from rear); anatomical LEFT now viewer LEFT has ivory replacement front/outer thigh, with only its wrapping ivory side edge seen from rear. Rear knee joints are dark hinges, NOT front kneecaps. Both leg lengths equal. Rear calves are coherent tan/ivory shell backs and dark ankle/heel pivots, use existing panel wrapping without duplicating front shin panels. Broad boxing boots show tan/ivory rear heel structure and short deep-red heel protectors; front red TOE caps do NOT face rear camera. Both flat soles share floor line.
Keep same heavy mature proportions and long-legged support as FRONT; no shrug, crouch, narrow weak legs or childlike head. Exactly one back figure.
